summary: Extended guard-destructive-git.sh with three independent over-staging detectors (git add -A/--all, bare dot, git commit -a/-am/--all), placed before the MATCHED destructive chain so a snapshot marker never exempts over-staging. Fixed two prose locations that taught blocked commands. 26/26 manual verification cases passed against the tracked source hook.
decisions_made: Over-staging detectors block independently (own exit 2) before the MATCHED chain, so a fresh snapshot marker never exempts over-staging.
Quoted spans stripped before flag-scanning to avoid false-positiving on -a-containing commit messages.
No exemption built for git-snapshot.sh; its internal git add -A is invisible to the hook.
dead_ends: Skipped real git-snapshot.sh for the marker test (would stash a concurrent session's changes); constructed the marker file directly instead.
